acceptance_checks.description: Object staged to incoming/<basename> is byte-identical to the landed object (S3 copy, no decode step anywhere).
Object also copied to archive/<basename>; no embedded wall-clock timestamp in the key (deterministic keys, unlike the legacy .YYYYMMDDHHMMSS suffix).
Landed object deleted from landing/ after successful staging (parity with the legacy drop-dir rm; replaces the size-settle hack: S3 Object Created only fires on complete objects).
Only keys matching landing/CUSTBILL*.dat are staged; anything else is moved to quarantine/ and recorded in the DynamoDB ledger, never silently dropped.
Re-delivery of the same object (EventBridge at-least-once) produces the same incoming/ and archive/ state, no duplicates or failures.
Role ow-tp-<ns>-ingest-role: read+delete on landing/*, write on incoming/*, archive/*, quarantine/* only; no bucket-wide write; trust policy conditioned on source account.
Failures raise (no 2>/dev/null || true equivalent); Lambda retries then surfaces via the rule's DLQ path. No lock files.

malformed_record_policy.details: Ingest is record-agnostic transport: it must not inspect or reject record content; content-level anomalies are the parser's to surface.

empty_input_semantics.details: No landed objects means no events and no invocations; nothing is written and nothing fails (legacy poll exits 0 on an empty drop dir).
